result:
I ran the protocol for all four materials. The decision logs, LCI sheets, `protocol_issues.md` and `summary.md` are in `runs/batch_4/`. The mycelium result is the weakest part (see below).

| Material | Route | GWP-fossil A1–A3 (kg CO2e/kg) | ÖKOBAUDAT median (n) | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| plywood | exact match, `market for plywood` RER | 0.496 | 0.405 (3) | CHECK 1 pass (1.22×) |
| AAC | approximate match, `market for autoclaved aerated concrete block` CH | 0.359 | 0.461 (11) | CHECK 2 pass (0.78×) |
| mycelium | built from scratch | 0.656 | none | CHECK 3 "no check possible" |
| concrete | built from scratch, flagged | 0.118 | 0.0728 (63, C30/37) | CHECK 2 and CHECK 3 both fail (1.62×) |

- **Concrete:** I kept the built LCI in the REVIEW, because it is marginally closer to the median (distance 0.620 vs 0.621). Cement carries about 95 % of the result. The EPD set is mostly low-clinker ECOPact mixes.
- **Mycelium:**
  - Incubation and moulding got no rows, because I found no machine datasheet with both power and throughput.
  - Pasteurising uses a small commercial autoclave as a proxy.
  - The drying values come from a search-result summary of a brochure whose PDF I could not read. That heat row is 36 % of the result and should be verified.
- **Machine data in general:** I could not find three complete datasheets for any step. Concrete mixing has three machines, but two of them borrow the 90 s cycle time from the third.
- **Strict D1 reading:** Concrete and AAC fail D1 because of extra constituents (slag and admixture; process water). I applied the rule literally, so both went through D1b.
- **Wear rows:** The machine (wear) share is under 0.01 % wherever machine rows exist.
- **Waste fallbacks:** Plywood, AAC and mycelium all use fallback waste classes (W2).
- **Assumed values:** TiR = 1 for every dataset (the time period isn't readable in Brightway), and machine life is 40,000 h (8 years × 5,000 h/year).

The ÖKOBAUDAT numbers come from its API, latest release OBD_2024_III (13 Nov 2026). `protocol_issues.md` lists 18 points where the protocol was ambiguous and what I did about each. `scripts/` has the code that produced the files.
